note: Benton County Conservation park on 312 wooded acres above the Cedar River, about 2 mi south of Urbana. The camp loop is on the bluff top, set back from the river in the trees. Boat ramp and river fishing, hiking trails, and a 21-hole disc golf course that draws players from far away. Nearest county dump station is at Rodgers Park. Big-rig fit is not posted. --Claude
